name: Katsuragi Yayoi
source: A private detective who runs the Katsuragi Private Detective Agency. She’s a highly talented woman who managed to get the agency back on track after it almost shut down following a certain event. She’s best friends with Marina, and she’s also Kojiroh’s ex-girlfriend.
